independent_result_summary: Fixed-digest majority canonicalization: if every full valid encoding vector is within Hamming radius t of one decoded vector and 4t<k, pad p=K^k xor r formed from one honest valid opening vector lets every full valid opening vector recover the same bit K.

The published VTDH per-index hiding game is sufficient for a standard classical joint-bit hybrid for the weaker public view that omits openings, but the source paper is PPT/classical as stated; QPT lift remains unproved.
The paper's HBG transform generates a fresh digest during GenBits, so it does not provide future NP witnesses openings to a WKEM setup-fixed digest.
Because setup itself can create a valid fixed-digest opening without a source witness, source extraction cannot apply to every valid opening; the missing source gate must be simulation-aware.
limitations: No computational security is inferred from the checker.
No QPT theorem is claimed for the concrete VTDH LWE instantiation.
No generic-NP simulation-aware fixed-digest source-opening compiler is constructed.
No malicious-secure setup/abort proof or practical end-to-end parameter set is supplied.
